_help: Store settings. Edit on GitHub and commit; the site updates in about a minute. All money is US dollars.
card_fee: Stripe's fee. Prices are raised by this much so the band keeps take_home_price after fees. Check stripe.com/pricing now and then.
international_card_percent: Stripe's extra fee for cards from outside the US. Added to Canada and worldwide orders.
round_prices_up_to: listed prices round up to this step (0.5 means $20.60 shows as $21.00). Use 0.01 for no rounding.
shipping: what you pay for postage, per zone. 'letter' is used when the whole order is stickers; otherwise 'parcel'. first = first item, each_additional = every item after that.
free_shipping: set enabled to true to ship free when the items add up to minimum_order or more, in the listed zones.
pay_apps: your handles. Leave one empty ("") to hide it. If all are empty, the Venmo / Cash App / Zelle option is hidden.
checkout_api: the address of the checkout worker. Leave empty to show the store with checkout turned off.
